flora: Walnut-like leaf (pinnately compound, several pairs of leaflets on one stalk)
Early walnut fruit (green, fleshy outer husk enclosing a hard-shelled nut)
Walnut-like sapling (sturdy, straight stem with large compound leaves)
Bark detail (deeply furrowed, dark grey or brownish-grey with diamond-shaped ridges)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; tactile textures on the rugged, 'craggy' bark; emphasis on the unique compound leaf shape for identification; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single compound leaf stalk; Top-Right: The green-husked fruit; Bottom-Left: A young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the deeply furrowed dark bark.
visual_logic.ground: A mix of ochre-colored clay and dark grey siltstone fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to accentuate the deep shadows in the bark furrows.
